headline: HBO Max is putting on vertical shorts
summary: HBO Max is launching a new vertical video feed. This feature aims to help users discover new content. It mirrors TikTok-like feeds on other streaming platforms.

headline: 4GB graphics cards are back
summary: Modern 4GB VRAM GPUs are reappearing due to component shortages. An AMD Radeon RX 9050 with 4GB VRAM was spotted on ASRock's website. This trend reflects rising tech prices and supply chain issues.

headline: Apple’s reported ‘HomePad’ may launch as early as October
summary: Rumors suggest Apple's new home hub device could launch by October. The alleged 'HomePad with a screen' will compete with smart home devices. A new report from Bloomberg's Mark Gurman sheds light on its details.

headline: Twelve South’s stylish charging tray now delivers more wireless power with a smaller footprint
summary: Twelve South has released a new, compact Valet charging tray. The updated design offers increased wireless power in a smaller form factor. It is ideal for spaces where saving space is a priority.

headline: Call of Duty: Black Ops Fans Can't Agree on Which Map to Play
summary: Call of Duty: Black Ops fans are frustrated with map voting. Players are reportedly refusing to vote for different maps. This creates a lack of variety and dissatisfaction among the community.

headline: Supergirl Now Available to Watch Online After Box Office Struggles
summary: The movie 'Supergirl' is now available for digital viewing. This follows a disappointing performance at the box office. Fans can stream the film after its theatrical release struggles.

headline: Batman: Caped Crusader Season 2 Review - Darker, Deadlier, but Still Flawed
summary: Season 2 of Batman: Caped Crusader has been reviewed. It's described as darker and deadlier, yet not without its flaws. The season blends detective noir with deep character psychological portraits.

headline: First Look at Three Cards From The Hobbit's New Magic: The Gathering Crossover
summary: Magic: The Gathering has unveiled new cards from its Hobbit crossover. Three specific cards have been revealed. The collaboration brings Middle-earth lore into the popular card game.

headline: The moment Tuesday's powerful earthquake hit Japan
summary: A powerful earthquake struck Japan's Kyushu island on July 28. Video footage captures the impact across various locations. The event occurred on a Tuesday, causing significant tremors.

headline: Some parents on benefits to get up to £4,500 for child starting apprenticeship
summary: Parents on benefits could receive up to £4,500. This incentive is for their child starting an apprenticeship. The policy aims to encourage apprenticeship take-up among eligible families.

headline: Uefa reacts with fury to Infantino World Cup plan
summary: Uefa has reacted furiously to proposals from Fifa. Fifa suggested seeking private investment for its competitions, including the World Cup. European football's governing body expressed strong opposition.

headline: Wildfires in south-west France flare up as region braces for new 40C heatwave
summary: Wildfires in south-west France have reignited. The region, Gironde, is bracing for a new heatwave of 40C. Firefighters face challenges in containing the blazes amidst rising temperatures.
